page.title: Le tue app
page.lead: Registra un'app così i climber possono collegarla al loro diario Boardsesh. Non viene condiviso nulla finché un climber non approva la tua app nella schermata di consenso.

metadata.title: Developer terms | Boardsesh for developers
metadata.description: The terms an app accepts when it registers to connect to Boardsesh accounts.

terms.title: Boardsesh developer terms

draftNotice.title: Draft, not in force
draftNotice.body: The Boardsesh team has not approved these terms yet. They may change before any app connects to a real climber’s account.

terms.intro: These terms apply to anyone who registers an app that connects to Boardsesh accounts through the Boardsesh API. You accept them when you register an app, for yourself and for everyone who works on the app with you.

items.purpose: Use what a climber shares only for the features they connected your app for.
items.noSale: Don’t sell or rent it, and don’t share it with anyone for advertising, profiling or data brokering.
items.setterClimbs: A tick comes with the climb it is on, including a draft or an unlisted climb someone else set. That detail is there so the climber can see their own logbook. Don’t publish it, show it to other people or build a list of climbs from it.
items.delete: Delete a climber’s Boardsesh data when they disconnect your app or ask you to, unless they ask you to keep it.
items.privacyPolicy: Have a privacy policy that says what you do with Boardsesh data, and register its link with your app. Climbers see it before they approve.
items.security: Keep tokens and client secrets on your server or in the device’s secure storage, never in a URL or a log. If you learn that one leaked, or that someone reached climbers’ data without permission, tell us at legal@boardsesh.com within 72 hours.

items.limits: Stay within the rate limits, and wait as long as Retry-After says.
items.scopes: Ask only for the scopes you use. Don’t try to get around a scope, a limit, a suspension or a climber’s choices.
items.catalog: Don’t use the API to copy Boardsesh’s climb catalogue. The public nightly snapshots are there for that.
items.service: Board control, sessions and the climb catalogue are not part of the API. An app whose accounts, climbing, board control or sessions run on Boardsesh’s servers needs our written permission, which we don’t currently give.

items.worksWith: Say that your app works with Boardsesh, for example “Works with Boardsesh” or “Import your Boardsesh logbook”. Don’t suggest that Boardsesh made, reviewed or endorses your app.
items.ownName: Don’t use Boardsesh, or anything that looks like it, in your app’s name, publisher name or icon.
items.boardBrands: Kilter, Tension, MoonBoard and other board names belong to their owners. Use them only to say which board a climb is on, and don’t suggest that a board maker endorses your app or Boardsesh.

items.suspend: Suspend or delete an app that breaks these terms, puts climbers at risk or overloads the service. When we suspend an app, the console shows you the reason.
items.changes: Change the API under the versioning rules in the developer docs, and change these terms. The console shows the new version, and the next app you register accepts it.
items.asIs: The API is provided as it is, with no promise that it is always available or free of errors.

ending.title: Stopping
ending.body: You can delete your app in the console at any time, and every climber’s connection to it ends at once. Then delete the Boardsesh data you hold, unless a climber asked you to keep theirs.
